author: /root/final_coordination_audit
reviewIndependence: Reviewer did not author or modify these four coordination files. Static inspection only; no lock or controller was exercised.

checks.detail: Only the official performance controller and publication lease acquire shared locks. No ordinary development, functional test, build, capture, commit or push is gated on a global lock or another lot availability. Peer acknowledgment and availability waits are explicitly disabled.

verify_cost_contract parses the exact contract schema and status and binds both checkouts, native versions/counts/digests/manifests, source commits, baseline Site version, fixed ABBA population/command, strict per-game global rule and exact four structural paths. All contract fingerprints must belong to the controller freeze; all seven historical tools match the actual baseline commit and the candidate copies.

All native files, both historical runners, controller/helper, contract, cases, public traces, proof inputs and readiness are frozen. Committed native path sets and complete canonical native maps are checked. Candidate source commits may precede later documentation commits only with ancestry and identical native bytes; full execution HEAD must stay fixed. Baseline HEAD must equal the published source.

Readiness requires closed own commands/workers and explicit linked isolation evidence, basis, scope and limitations; it rejects flock as sole evidence. Before launch and during measurement the controller observes only its visible namespace and own checkout work, with CPU/load/cgroup information retained. No ancient PID, peer ACK epoch or cross-namespace global quiet is required or inferred.

Each mutex is acquired once with nonblocking flock on a canonical regular file opened with O_NOFOLLOW/O_CLOEXEC. Path and descriptor device/inode identity are checked before and after acquisition and during use. A busy mutex returns 75 without waiting or retry. Finally releases only the owned descriptor; no lock file is unlinked or replaced, including after errors.

The only measured command is the unchanged historical ABBA runner in a new process group. The controller uses Linux subreaper adoption, TERM/KILL bounds and PPID closure to discover escaped owned descendants; startTicks are rechecked before individual signals. All owned descendants must be absent before success. Cleanup and lock release are attempted on failure, timeout and catchable signals; incomplete cleanup cannot qualify.

Unlocked preflight is limited to 180 seconds. The 1800-second acquisition-to-measurement bound includes post-acquisition integrity checks; TERM and KILL each have 10 seconds and locked final integrity has 60 seconds, for a declared 1880-second maximum exclusive scope. Final log fingerprinting is after release with its own 60-second reserve. No automatic retry or sample selection exists.

Controller success is completed_pending_independent_analysis with actual window completion, four passed series, frozen inputs, no owned descendants and retained logs. It does not accept the cost, assert cross-namespace quiet or publish anything.

The publication helper is a separate nonblocking lease with a fixed 300-second bound, exact owner control lines, source/input checks and finally release. Abort, EOF, signal or timeout cannot imply remote success. The helper neither deploys nor asserts deployment completion; the owner must freshly verify remote publication identity, distinct version, audience and actual packaged source under the lease.

resolvedFindings.resolution: performance.py now semantically verifies the contract and all source, command, population, rule, tool and input bindings before lock acquisition, immediately under the lock and during final integrity verification.

acceptableIsolationScope.basis: Shared current official mutex, exact frozen owned checkouts, actually closed own commands/workers, no visible interfering work in those checkouts, and retained current namespace/CPU/cgroup/load observations.
acceptableIsolationScope.unknown: Ordinary work outside the visible namespace or host cannot be inferred absent and is not prohibited by these helpers.

requiredAtExecution: Prepare an honest frozen readiness declaration with actual closed own work and linked current observations; do not merely empty status lists while workers remain active.
Accept only a terminal successful controller receipt with intact current inode, descriptor closed, matching lease released, no surviving owned descendants and complete retained evidence.
After performance release, complete the independent cost analysis and review before final publication qualification.

During the separate publication lease, freshly check the remote Site version/source/audience and bind the exact pushed and packaged commit; retain the actual deployment result and explicit owner release.
limitations: Static review did not execute either controller, acquire a mutex, mutate shared status or test signal/timeout paths.
The isolation basis is limited and prospective; residual work outside the namespace and normal runtime noise remain measurement limitations.

SIGKILL, host failure, blocked kernel I/O or storage failure can prevent a terminal receipt. A nonterminal receipt is not proof of cleanup; the documented descendant protection is best effort in those cases.
Filesystem operations are subject to operating-system scheduling/I/O; declared supervisor bounds do not constitute a hard real-time guarantee.
A remote publication exceeding the lease must retain its actual unresolved identity and status; the helper cannot terminate or certify a remote deployment.
